answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is released only after a long sequence of verified, useful transactions, building a layered record like shale strata. A single honest agent passes through the narrow canyon of checks cheaply, but an attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund every one, so cost scales linearly while honest users pay almost nothing extra. Independent auditors, like a raven watching from above, sample work and slash deposits for fraud, making mass fakery expensive and easy to detect.
